About This Film

Bhooth Bangla is an upcoming Hindi film directed by Priyadarshan, releasing on Apr 10, 2026. Cast includes Akshay Kumar · Wamiqa Gabbi · Paresh Rawal · Tabu · Rajpal Yadav. Budget estimated at ₹120 Cr.

Boxoffy tracks all India box office data using Box Office India (BOI) as primary source, cross-referenced with Sacnilk and Koimoi. All India Net figures are domestic only — overseas collections are separate. This page will be updated with confirmed Day 1, opening weekend, and final collection data as they become available.

Data Methodology

All box office figures on this page are India Net (domestic only, after GST deduction) sourced from Box Office India (primary), cross-referenced with Sacnilk and Koimoi. Advance booking figures are gross (pre-GST). Worldwide figures include overseas gross. Projections and predictions are Boxoffy analytical models — not official figures. All figures in ₹ Crore (1 Crore = 10 million).
